descriptors.concept_name: Indian Accounting Standards Applicability and Presentation for NBFCs
descriptors.definition: Non-Banking Financial Companies must comply with Indian Accounting Standards pursuant to specified company rules. Financial statements are prepared utilizing the structured balance sheet format established under Division III of Schedule III.
instrument_references: Rule 4 (1)(iv) of the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015
Division III of Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from manufacturing or general corporate financial statement layouts by specialized financial sector asset and liability classifications.

descriptors.concept_name: Applicability of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) on NBFCs
descriptors.definition: Certain Non-Banking Financial Companies are mandated to structure their accounting processes around specific Indian Accounting Standards. Compliance follows regulatory frameworks established via statutory company rules and subsequent amendments.
instrument_references: Rule 4 (1)(iv) of the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015
inclusion: Mandatory adopters of Ind AS among non-banking financial entities
exclusion: Entities exempted from Ind AS integration
nearby_distinctions: Separates entities governed by general accounting standards from those subjected to specialized financial sector Ind AS mandates.

descriptors.concept_name: Format for Preparation of Financial Statements by NBFCs under Ind AS
descriptors.definition: Compliant Non-Banking Financial Companies construct balance sheets using a distinct regulatory layout prescribed under corporate legislation. This layout categorizes items systematically into financial and non-financial assets, liabilities, and equity elements.
instrument_references: Division III under Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013
inclusion: Assets sub-classified into financial and non-financial components
Liabilities sub-classified into debt securities, borrowings, and deposits
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from standard corporate schedules by featuring specific financial sector line items such as subordinated liabilities and debt securities.

descriptors.concept_name: Difference between Division II and Division III of Schedule III
descriptors.definition: Financial statement presentation for NBFCs under Division III diverges from general corporate structures in Division II through unique liquidity ordering and specific disclosure thresholds. Key variations include face-value revenue disclosures and explicit reporting for credit-impaired receivables.
instrument_references: Division III of Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013
inclusion: Liquidity-based balance sheet sequencing for NBFCs
Specific thresholds for other income or expenditure disclosures
LLP partner/member debt disclosures under receivables
exclusion: Standard manufacturing entity presentation rules under Division II
nearby_distinctions: Contrasts general corporate formats which prohibit liquidity ordering with NBFC layouts that mandate it alongside stricter line-item disclosures on the face of the profit and loss statement.
